data.text: Criterion 2 is not checked, and the reason is not this change. 930 of 931 tests pass; the one failure is test/package.test.ts complaining that package.json declares a dependency on kadence ^0.4.1 that nothing imports. That line was already in the working tree before this task started - someone ran npm i kadence inside kadence - and reverting it is a change to uncommitted work that is not mine to make. Everything else is green, typecheck is clean, and the page rendering has its own perf case: flow 0.1 ms / 14 KB, cfd over a 730-day window 1.7 ms / 301 KB.
